The residual is two-way event risk, not a signed trend. Buy the 1-month USDJPY ATM straddle. Paper stays HOLD because executable_marks.options is empty; this seat will not invent a premium or substitute spot just to feed the 5.00% ACT/365 clock on the full $100m.

expression_comparison.rationale: FACT: USDJPY 20d realized 11.04 versus 60d 9.26 is the widest USD G10 realized vol in this snapshot, while the 1y percentile is only 52.2 — a jump from mid-range, not a stretched directional extreme. FACT: EURUSD was -0.18% 1d while USDJPY was +1.41% 1d, so this is JPY-specific, not a broad USD trend that a dollar-spot book owns. FACT: the BoJ hike to 1.25% was not followed by a clean JPY-up spot response. INFERENCE: the mispricing is expression — residual risk is both tails, so a 1M ATM straddle dominates signed USDJPY spot and dominates paying US 2Y, which only owns the already-hiked US front end. UNKNOWN: no implied vol, skew, or premium exists in executable_marks.options, so options cannot be marked; that blocks paper OPEN, it does not license substituting spot.

trade.thesis: Causal question: after a same-week Fed 25bp hike that futures had already heavily priced and a BoJ hike to 1.25%, is residual USDJPY risk a signed drift that spot or US duration owns, or a jump whose sign is not identified? FACT: Fed raised 25bp to 3.75–4.00%; rate futures entered that decision with greater-than-90% probability of the hike; August CPI is cited as keeping the tightening bias intact; US 2Y is 4.76 and US 10Y is 5.01, both 99th-percentile 1y. FACT: BoJ raised its policy rate to 1.25%. FACT: USDJPY spot 157.88830715532288 as of 2026-09-18, +1.41% 1d, +2.50% 5d, -0.55% 1m, 20d RV 11.04, 60d RV 9.26, 1y percentile 52.2, 5y percentile 88.6. FACT: EURJPY +1.23% 1d / 20d RV 9.27; AUDJPY +1.50% 1d / 20d RV 9.18 — JPY crosses jumped together. FACT: CFTC TFF JPY as of 2026-09-15 (pre-BoJ) shows open interest 542802 contracts at the 99th 1y percentile; leveraged funds net long JPY 23170 (99th 1y, z 3.71) after +72268 on the week; dealers net short JPY 168570 after -129093 on the week. CME FX options volume/OI is unavailable. INFERENCE: textbook BoJ-hike-JPY-up spot failed in this window; leveraged-fund long JPY into the event was the wrong sign; the next jump can squeeze either tail. That is why a straddle, not USDJPY spot, owns the discrepancy. UNKNOWN: implied versus realized, 25d risk-reversal, and any option premium — none are in the packet, so no cheap-vol claim is made. AUDCAD at 99.8th 1y / 99.96th 5y with 20d RV 4.38 below 60d 4.91 is a stretched-spot / compressing-vol screen, not a vol-expansion trade. USDCAD energy tails (Saudi Oman workaround versus weakening shock absorbers, BoC energy pass-through) are two-way but 1d USDCAD was only +0.11% with modest RV; they are secondary to the live JPY jump.
trade.mispricing: The room will be tempted to express the Fed/BoJ week as long or short USDJPY spot, or as paying US 2Y. Spot requires a sign from a 52nd-percentile 1y level after the jump has already printed; US 2Y already sits at the 99.8th 1y percentile, so duration owns known information. The unowned piece is unsigned USDJPY jump risk. Options are the instrument that owns it. Implied vol is UNKNOWN, so this is an expression discrepancy, not a quantified IV-versus-RV edge.
